You may need to give your own emotions the freedom to express themselves.
TaroCard.Meaning: The King of Swords is primed for action, his weapon ready, as he pauses to weigh the situation. He is highly analytical, often pursuing a career in law or publishing. His leadership is unquestioned.

TaroCard.DirectReading: The Ace of Pentacles signifies an overall improvement in your financial affairs. Expect an abundance of new opportunities, particularly in relation to your career. This would be the time to start a new business or to promote yourself. The Ace of Pentacles often indicates a job promotion or some form of recognition for the work you have completed. On a personal level, the Ace of Pentacles is a card that indicates that you are becoming more grounded and stable. You may feel a new sense of security or material prosperity. In love Tarot, the Ace of Pentacles can indicate a committed and dependable relationship.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: In a reversed position, the Ace of Pentacles can indicate financial delays or setbacks. Investments could struggle and you may feel financially insecure. An overemphasis on the material could hamper your personal growth. You need to be careful that you are not being too reckless with your finances. In love Tarot, a reversed Ace of Pentacles can indicate that the timing is off with a new relationship. Your expectations may be unrealistic. A partnership may struggle over financial matters.
TaroCard.Meaning: A large Pentacle in the sky rests upon a bed of lilies, surrounded by golden clouds. Aces signify largesse and new beginnings. Anticipate a new career, sudden prosperity, opportunities for tremendous growth.

TaroCard.DirectReading: This is a period when you may find yourself juggling a number of responsibilities. You may find yourself being pulled in too many directions. It’s important to find your inner balance and become adaptable to your circumstances. There may be some difficulty managing your finances. Perhaps you are struggling to pay down your debt, or you may find yourself in a state of financial instability. In a tarot reading, the Two of Pentacles warns you not to increase your debt. In love Tarot, however, you may meet a new potential romantic interest.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: You may have to make important decisions that you have been unwilling to face. An overall lack of focus is causing you to feel overwhelmed and unable to get tasks completed. It would be wise to take the time to balance your life. It may be useful to prioritize your responsibilities. You need to review you course of action and make suitable changes. This is the time to budget and become aware of your spending habits.
TaroCard.Meaning: A youth juggles on the beach, oblivious to the stormy seas. Juggling is a difficult skill to learn. Don't lose sight of other circumstances as you try to balance two areas of your life. Don't take on more than you can handle.

TaroCard.DirectReading: This is the time to incorporate your skills in everyday matters. In this case, it is important to stay on track and trust that your skills will bring you success and recognition. Your hard work and diligence will bring you success and rewards. The Three of Pentacles refers to the things that occur within the physical plane; career, education, financial security, and health. New opportunities that involve money may become available to you. You will feel satisfied with your work and your skills can lead to advancement. In love Tarot, the Three of Pentacles can indicate an improvement in an important relationship. Your ability to communicate will bring you closer to your partner.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: There may be a lack of cooperation in your work environment. It’s important to remember to utilize your negotiation abilities. You may need to further your education or increase your skill level. If your heart is not in your work, it may be showing. You may feel as though you are not getting the credit that you deserve. This would be a great time to explore your options. You need to focus your energy and trust in your abilities. In love Tarot, there may need to be better channels of communication. One partner may be overly focused on their career.
TaroCard.Meaning: This is the card of the master craftsman. This card indicates the pinnacle of one's profession. People look up to you and admire your good example.

TaroCard.DirectReading: This is a period of financial and emotional security. You have put in the effort and developed solid foundations. Your hard work will pay off and you may acquire a new position of status. A new opportunity may offer you a better sense of financial well being. If you have been thinking of buying a new home, this would be the time to do it. The Four of Pentacles is the card of material possessions. You can expect a growth in your financial status. You need to be aware, however, not too become overly attached to your material assets. In love Tarot, you may need to explore the intentions of your relationships. Are you using a relationship to gain security?
TaroCard.ReverseReading: In its reversed position, The Four of Pentacles often refers to unjustified fears surrounding your financial security. You may be overly focusing on the future and are failing to enjoy the present. In some cases, a reversed Four of Pentacles can indicate reckless spending. Your budget may be limited. In love Tarot, you may need to let go of your expectations regarding your relationship. There may be issues of control or fears of abandonment.
TaroCard.Meaning: The miser clings to his goods with all his might. He can't move, because he's holding on with his feet. This card is a hint to loosen your grip on material things, in order to help restore the flow of creativity and energy.

TaroCard.DirectReading: You may feel as though you are all alone. The Five of Pentacles can also refer to feelings of sadness. Have faith. If there are aspects in your life that you do not feel are working for you, this would be the time to let them go. The Five of Pentacles urges you to break free from old behaviors or confining situations. In financial matters, you may feel as though you are having a difficult time meeting your obligations. You need to become aware of your spending habits. The Five of Pentacles may indicate a relationship that is struggling over financial issues or lacks permanence.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: A reversed Five of Pentacles refers to the end of a crisis or period of struggle. Issues surrounding money will improve. If you have been unhappy in your current job, things may take a turn for the better. Feelings of sadness are finally lifting. Financial struggles are coming to an end.
TaroCard.Meaning: Two beggars pass a church window, but fail to see the light within. This card could indicate errors and missed opportunities leading to financial trouble. Help is available - don't be afraid to ask.

TaroCard.DirectReading: This will be a period of abundance. Your hard work will finally pay off. Material success is within your grasp. In a tarot reading, the Six of Pentacles can suggest that you can receive a financial gift, loan or an opportunity to participate in a profitable endeavor. A job promotion is possible. This is also the time to share what you have earned with others. You may want to support a charity that has significance for you. In love Tarot, this is a time of growth and giving. A new romance will be based on shared ideas and values.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: This is the time to watch your spending. Carelessness and lack of responsibility could cause you financial instability. If you are doing business with partners or investors you need to be cautious of misrepresentations and falsified information. You may be too focused on material satisfaction. In love Tarot, the Six of Pentacles reversed may indicate that one partner is focusing on his or her own needs and is failing to take their partners needs into consideration.
TaroCard.Meaning: As he measures his wealth, the rich man holds out some coins to the poor. This is the card of the philanthropist.

TaroCard.DirectReading: This is the time to be patient. Practicality will serve you. This may be a period in which things seem as if they are not moving forward. Growth is steady, but may be slow. This is not the time to halt your efforts. Your hard work will ultimately pay off in the end. You may feel frustrated or discouraged. Know that in the end your endeavors will be met with success. You may need to review your current circumstances. Identify what is working and change the things that aren’t. In love Tarot, there may be an important shift in a relationship.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: Do not get discouraged! You may be giving up on a project too soon. Your own feelings of apprehension and financial insecurity are influencing your decisions. Stay on course. Things are not as bad as they appear. Your impatience may hinder an important endeavor. In some cases, the reversed Seven of Pentacles can warn one of the repercussions of taking on too many risks. You may need to step back or take a break.
TaroCard.Meaning: A weary young peasant rests at the end of a long day in the field. This card is about patience. Things will happen, but not now.

TaroCard.DirectReading: More effort and work is required. Use your energy to build your skills. Your attention is on your career right now and you may find that you will advance quickly. Your enthusiasm and dedication will get you noticed. You may find yourself in the position of an apprentice or trainee. Be willing to take the time to learn a new skill. In love Tarot, this is a period of growth. New couples may enter a new phase in their relationship. There is a possibility for an engagement or marriage.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: You may be feeling bored or unchallenged in your work environment. You may not be working up to your potential. Make sure that you continue your education to further your skills. The more dedicated you are to enhancing your expertise, the more it will pay off. Your lack of patience can hinder your progress or cause you trouble. In love Tarot, there may be an unwillingness to work on a relationship.
TaroCard.Meaning: A young craftsman, his tools around him, carefully examines his handiwork. Success can be achieved through old-fashioned hard work.

TaroCard.DirectReading: This is the time to enjoy your achievements. You are self-sufficient and independent. Your talents have finally paid off. This will be a period of material abundance. You may prefer a career that provides you with more autonomy. On a spiritual level, the Nine of Pentacles urges you to connect with nature. It will bring you peace and harmony. In love Tarot, there may be a need to take some time for yourself. It’s important to remember that within every partnership one must continue their own personal growth and development.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: Your self-reliance may be inhibiting you from getting close to others. You may be feeling isolated or lonely. It’s important to remember to share yourself with others. The Nine of Pentacles reversed reminds you to find a balance within all of your relationships. Financially, this is the time to be cautious in your business affairs. You may experience some financial setbacks.
TaroCard.Meaning: A woman stands in a vineyard holding a rare bird. Wisdom, knowledge, and talent are present, but no love life; this is a lonely time, to be met with a measure of detachment. Success, recognition, and wealth will follow.

TaroCard.DirectReading: Financially, this is the card of success and achievement. Financial security has, at last, been guaranteed. Your job has provided you with material success. You may receive a job promotion or partnership. You are emotionally satisfied and fulfilled. Family matters thrive. You may receive a pension or trust. Your new found security has enabled you to feel a new freedom. This is a great time to share your prosperity and wisdom with your friends, family and community. In love Tarot, the Ten of Pentacles can refer to marriage or a deep level of commitment. If you are single, you may meet a wealthy partner that is serious about marriage.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: Issues may come that concern your family. You may feel overwhelmed by parental responsibilities. There could be family disagreements in regards to an inheritance or the transferring of money. Your current financial security may be at risk. This is not the time to pursue uncertain investments or opportunities. You may need to restructure you finances.
TaroCard.Meaning: An old man surrounded by family and possessions contentedly strokes a dog. Life is full. The family is safe and secure.

TaroCard.DirectReading: The Page of Pentacles is quiet, determined and goal-oriented. He tends to be thoughtful and cautious. The Page of Pentacles often represents the beginning of new endeavors or relationships. Your ideas are beginning to solidify. You may be offered a new job or you may receive an invitation to participate in an exciting business venture. It’s important to pay close attention to details, particularly with signed contracts or agreements. You may hear from someone that you have been interested in. New communication about a project is possible. In love Tarot, the Page of Pentacles represents an introverted, inexperienced and idealistic person. However, they are also ambitious and driven.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: There may be delays or setbacks in an important project. Be careful not to overlook important details, particularly when it comes to contracts and documents. You may have to take a few steps backwards. There can also be a miscommunication or disagreement in the work environment or in a significant relationship. There may be too much emphasis on your finances and you are failing to appreciate the other aspects of your life.
TaroCard.Meaning: The Page is lost in thought, focused in coins before him. This is the card of the scholar. The Page has a thirst for knowledge and pursues it diligently.

TaroCard.DirectReading: The Knight of Pentacles is a diligent worker. He is extremely practical and detail oriented. Once The Knight of Pentacles has a goal in mind, he will not quit until he has achieved his objective. This is a period of patience and perseverance. You can expect things to develop slowly. The Knight of Pentacles urges you to not deviate from your goals. Know that in time, they will come to fruition. Money may suddenly come in from unexpected resources. There may be job related travel. In love Tarot, The Knight of Pentacles signifies a committed and long term relationship.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: You may experience some delays in reference to a project that you have been working on. You may find yourself confronted with new obstacles that need to be overcome. Financially, the reversed Knight of Pentacles can indicate issues that are influencing your financial security. Too much emphasis on practicality is hindering your creativity. Remember that proper planning and execution can help you to reach your goals. This is not the time to be careless or irresponsible. In love Tarot, a reversed Knight of Pentacles can indicate a partner that is reckless or inconsiderate.
TaroCard.Meaning: The Knight is depicted in carefully tilled, rolling field - the country squire on his estate. He takes his responsibilities seriously, and finishes what he starts. Loves the natural world.

TaroCard.DirectReading: The Queen of Pentacles is the symbol of mother earth. Able to multi-task, the Queen of Pentacles often represents the working mother. She has a good mind for business matters. She is a provider, focusing on the interest of her family. She appreciates the comforts of her home. Often the Queen of Pentacles refers to one’s creative endeavors. She is a card of manifestation and reminds you that you have the power to create a life of your choosing. This is the time to remain sensible. Your practical approach in business matters promises success. You can expect security within your relationship or in the work environment. In love Tarot, the Queen of Pentacles can often symbolize a loving and nurturing relationship.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: You may be focusing on appearances and are not paying attention to your true feelings. In a tarot reading, the reversed Queen of Pentacles can refer to your own issues with doubt and fear. Your apprehension and anxiety is causing you to lose confidence in yourself. Progress has been halted. The Queen of Pentacles reversed serves as a warning for greedy behavior or self-indulgence. In love Tarot, a reversed Queen of Pentacles can indicate control issues due to feelings of jealousy.
TaroCard.Meaning: Surrounded by fruit and flowers, the dark-haired Queen holds a rabbit - familiar symbol of fertility. A lover of luxury, she is quick to share her wealth.

TaroCard.DirectReading: The King of Pentacles has the ability to manifest his ideas through his determination. His achievements are the result of his perseverance and persistent efforts. He is a great provider and is dedicated to his family and community. This will be a period of great stability, both financially and emotionally. In work, you may find yourself in a position of authority or leadership. A sensible and prudent attitude will bring you success. You may receive important advice regarding financial concerns. In love Tarot, the King of Pentacles can represent a serious suitor. They will be dependable and appreciate commitment.
TaroCard.ReverseReading: The reversed King of Pentacles can indicate over-indulgence and materialism. This King can be disrespectful and opinionated. In a tarot reading, the reversed King of Pentacles warns one not to base their feelings of achievement and self-confidence on their financial success. He is there to remind you that money is not everything. In some cases, a reversed King of Pentacles can refer to someone that is influencing your life. He may be dishonest or inappropriate. He may have issues with his emotions and has the tendency to suppress his feelings.
TaroCard.Meaning: Dressed in rich robes, the King is surrounded by the trappings of success - castle, vineyard, cattle. He's a man at the top of his game - tough, but an excellent manager, and a devoted husband and friend. Could suggest agricultural pursuits - or stock market holdings.
